name: Disneyland Rancho del Zocalo Pollo Asado or Carne Asada Soft Flour Tacos & Rice (Mild Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Rancho del Zocalo Restaurante (Frontierland · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Rancho del Zocalo offers generous portions of flame-grilled chicken or carne asada and a Kids' Bean-Free Chicken Taco & Rice plate—swapping to soft flour tortillas and holding raw onions/lime keeps it gentle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pollo Asado or Carne Asada on soft flour tortillas (or the Kids' Taco Plate) with rice only—ask for no whole/refried beans, no raw onion/cilantro relish, no salsa, and no lime squeeze.
watchOuts: Standard plates include whole/refried pinto beans, pickled onions, and lime wedges—request plain meat, flour tortillas, and rice
